assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Drone-based blade inspection is standard practice across onshore and offshore fleets, sold as a routine service by multiple vendors with analytics attached. The incumbent (ground-based telephoto or rope access) is now the exception, which is the definition of a mature robotic task.
advance_criteria: Already at the top of the scale; watch for commoditisation of the service price
regress_criteria: Regulatory restriction of BVLOS operations that raises the cost per turbine

evidence_considered.sentence: SkySpecs targets task Blade visual inspection
SkySpecs inspections across utility-scale wind fleets serves task Blade visual inspection
